It is an imager and spectrograph with a wavelength coverage in the near-infrared (0.8–2.4 µm). Coating specifications apply for a larger wavelength range, driven by detector sensitivity. MICADO will equip the ELT with a first light capability for diffraction limited imaging at near-infrared wavelengths. The design of MICADO was driven by a desire for high sensitivity and resolution, astrometric accuracy, and wide wavelength coverage for spectroscopy. For more info see here: https://www.mpe.mpg.de/ir/micado NOVA’s role in the MICADO project Within MICADO NOVA is responsible for a cryogenic subsystem of the MICADO instrument: the filterwheels, pupilwheel, and Atmospheric Dispersion Corrector.
